entities.name: Lividus
entities.description: Aggressive elder dragon, strong in body but weak in mind, brother of Vaevictis, Rubra and Ravus.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: Elder dragon who ruled his siblings and was the only one of his brood to survive the war.

entities.name: Rubra
entities.description: Elder dragon sibling of Lividus, wounded by a poisoned bolt.

entities.name: Ravus
entities.description: Elder dragon sibling of Lividus, killed by a disintegration spell.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon commanding a human army who turned Lividus against Vaevictis.

events.summary: Lividus hatches in the second egg-fall by the Ur-Dragon and, with his siblings, guards their hunting territory against humans.
events.quote: Lividus was hatched during the Birth of the Elder Dragons

events.summary: Lividus and his brothers defeat Bolas's human army, though Rubra is wounded.
events.quote: the others defeated the army easily

events.summary: Human sorcerers kill Ravus with a disintegration spell and Lividus flames the ballistae in grief.
events.quote: he splintered like a rock heated until it explodes

events.summary: Bolas ignites Lividus's resentment, and Lividus turns on Vaevictis while Bolas escapes.
events.quote: Lividus rose to meet him with a roar

events.summary: Lividus dies at an unknown time; Vaevictis is the only one of his brood to survive.
events.quote: Vaevictis would be the only one of his brood to survive the Elder Dragon war

relations.quote: his siblings Vaevictis Asmadi , Rubra and Ravus

relations.note: turned on him at Bolas's urging
relations.quote: He was tired of Vaevictis' rule and his domineering ways.

relations.note: fought his army, then manipulated him
relations.quote: Lividus and his brothers were challenged by the human army of Nicol Bolas
